verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents the agent-building pieces: a single WebSocket Voice Agent API, system prompting, TTS model selection, a step-by-step first-agent guide and Node starter apps. Phone calling depends on an external carrier: a Twilio number streams audio to your own server, which bridges it to the Voice Agent API, so Deepgram supplies no phone number of its own. missing for 10: native phone-number provisioning without Twilio or a self-hosted bridge server, any evidence of a sub-hour time-to-first-call, independent hands-on corroboration of the setup experience.
